question: All of the following can be used to treat alcohol dependence except
analysis: Naltrexone, Acamprosate, and Disulfiram are all established treatments for alcohol dependence. Naltrexone works by reducing cravings, Acamprosate helps maintain abstinence, and Disulfiram causes unpleasant reactions when alcohol is consumed. Flumazenil, however, is primarily used as an antidote for benzodiazepine overdose and is not indicated for treating alcohol dependence.
